text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired (P12345) — inference-prod: spike in 5xx errors and tail latency >2s for text-gen. Trigger: anomaly-detector-rlq. Affects model-serve-v2 in us-west-2. Please ack and state ownership.
pranav: acked. I'm on it — looking at logs and current autoscale. grabbing context.
pagerduty-bot: pranav acknowledged the page.
elaine: thanks. I'll own customer comms and status page updates. Which customers are hit?
sahil: early look shows error rate from svc-inference-gw -> model-serve-v2. Rolling 500s from grpc timeouts to backend. Token latency also up. Sampling logs: ```ERROR model-serve: kv-cache miss timeout after 1200ms | trace=ab12cd34 | conn=137``` 
matt: are we under heavy traffic from any scheduled jobs? I don't see scheduled spikes in prometheus for the last 30m.
pranav: not a traffic spike. It looks like one of the recent kernel optimizations for attention kernels on the node group may be regressing for long sequences. Node pool 7 shows higher CPU steal.
jordan: can we fail over to model-serve-v1 (quantized) as a short-term mitigation?
pranav: yes, I'm going to enable fallback routing policy to v1 for new requests and drain v2. will post command.
pranav: running -> ```redwoodctl router update --cluster inference-prod --route default --fallback model-serve-v1 --weight 100``` 
incident-bot: Command executed by pranav: routing updated. New traffic now going to model-serve-v1.
elaine: updating status page: "Mitigation in progress — traffic shifted to fallback model; investigating root cause." linking status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/P12345
sahil: after fallback, 5xx rate dropped by ~80% and p95 latency went from 2.4s -> 480ms. good short-term.
matt: I'll open a dedicated node-pool investigation ticket for the kernel optimization rollout. Tagging infra team.
pranav: taking on the RCA for the runtime change. quick note: will collect kernel/kernel-module versions, container images, and recent infra deploys. dumping a short log slice: ```node=ip-10-0-7-21 kernel=5.15.0-rt error=nvml_timeout stack=...``` 
jordan: any customer-facing impact severity? mark as sev2 if > 10% requests affected or any SLA breach.
elaine: customer tally: 7 customers saw degraded responses; 1 enterprise (Acme Corp) saw >30% errors in last 10m. I'm drafting an alert to Acme CSM now.
pranav: plan: (1) keep fallback routing for now, (2) revert the kernel optimization in node pool 7 and run canary, (3) instrument extra KV-cache metrics. Rolling items into a short action list in the incident doc.
elaine: ETA for external update to Acme: 30m with current mitigations noted.
sahil: also enabling increased KV-cache timeouts as a temporary knob: ```kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-serve -c runtime KV_CACHE_TIMEOUT_MS=2500``` — doing now.
incident-bot: escalation timer set: 10m. If no progress, escalate to eng-sre-leads.
pranav: working with infra to roll back optimization on node-pool-7. infra runbook step: ```infractl pool rollback node-pool-7 --to-image sha:0f3a2``` 
matt: oncall infra is aware and standing by.
elainetypo: (small typo message deleted) 
elaine: Acme notified via email + CSM ping. Will post verbatim when sent.
pranav: quick status: rollback queued, expecting nodes back in ~12m. traffic to v1 stable.
jordan: thumbs on logs: any risk of data loss? sounds safe — stateless inference path.
elaine: customer communications sent to Acme and two other larger customers. copy: "We observed elevated error rates; we have shifted traffic to a fallback model and are investigating; we will follow up with RCA." (copied in incident doc)
sahil: after the kernel rollback completes, we'll run a canary to validate before re-routing. will prepare canary config.
pranav: rollback completed on 3/3 nodes; testing canary now. test prompt sequences passing. will not shift traffic until canary green.
incident-bot: pranav set incident status: in_progress. P12345 severity: high.
elaine: adding brief timeline to the incident doc and tagging ops for postmortem.
matt: linking runbooks and relevant PRs in the doc: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/PR/2983
pranav: final note for this thread: ownership -> pranav (lead), ela ine handling comms, sahil infra runtime changes. handing off active monitoring to pranav for next 45m then will rotate to SRE rotation.
elaine: thanks all. will send another customer update in 30m or earlier if anything changes. :thumbsup:
pranav: closing loop here — will file RCA once we have full logs and kernel profiling. marking this thread as claimed.
